name: Invisible
source:
I did something terrible to my best friend.
She's probably mad at me, she might even hold a grudge against me, is what I was worrying about. But when I met her again, she greeted me with a smile: "Long time no see," she said.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23842]Freem[/url]]
translation:
我对最好的朋友做了一件很过分的事。
她大概在生我的气，甚至可能恨着我，我一直这样担心着。可再次见面时，她却微笑着向我打招呼，说了声“好久不见”。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23842]Freem![/url]]
